h: Nkechi Blessing says nobody supported her when she was down as she finds her spark again
p: Nollywood actress Nkechi Blessing has reportedly said she is rediscovering herself after a period of low energy and low confidence. She is said to have noted that few people stood by her during the difficult time.
more: Fans have reportedly sent messages of encouragement online.
She did not name anyone in the remarks reported.
